name: contrail
description: Contrail — live flight tracking: map, 3D, playback, airports, alerts

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @contrail/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @contrail/server" "npm run dev -w @contrail/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @contrail/shared && npm run build -w @contrail/server && npm run build -w @contrail/web
